_header.title: TYPESCRIPT TYPE-CHECK SETTINGS
version_1_2_changes: Checks tests/ as well as src/. tests/node.d.ts describes the Node built-ins
the tests import, which removes VS Code's red lines under node:test,
version_1_1_changes: Added this _header block. TypeScript ignores keys it doesn't know.
version_1_0_changes: New. Strict type checking for src/, with no build output.
description: Used by VS Code and by the optional type check (npm run check). Node runs the
.ts files without it. Only erasable TypeScript is allowed (no enum, namespace or
parameter properties), so Node and a later build step only strip the types.
notes: src/ and tests/ are checked. Node's own modules are described by
tests/node.d.ts, not by an npm package.
When the Chrome pages arrive they will need Chrome API types added to "types".
